chunks: But We bore him on a (vessel made) of planks and oakum,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the construction of Noah's Ark?
ai.summary: The phrase 'dhat al-alwah wa dusur' (a vessel of planks and nails) is interpreted by Shia exegetes such as Al-Tabarsi and Al-Qummi as referring specifically to the Ark of Noah, highlighting the divine engineering that allowed it to float despite being made of wood. This construction serves as a tangible sign of God's power over nature, reinforcing the narrative of salvation for the faithful amidst the destruction of the disbelievers.
